name: RADIUS Natural Biodegradable Silk Floss
description: RADIUS silk floss. The brand's current product page states pure silk coated with organic coconut oil and organic carnauba wax, and states the floss is PFAS-free and made without PTFE.
features: The current product page says the floss is pure silk, unscented, 33 yards, coated with organic coconut oil and organic carnauba wax, and free from PFAS and PTFE.
That page answers "Is RADIUS Silk Floss PFAS-free?" with "Yes, it is completely PFAS-free and made without synthetic coatings like PTFE." It also says silk is not vegan.
A RADIUS article dated May 7, 2015 lists the natural biodegradable silk floss as pure silk thread and candelilla wax. The current page names carnauba and coconut oil. Read the package.
Amazon ASIN B0GL3XHLQN is a 3-pack whose listing describes silk, coconut oil, and carnauba wax. The PFAS sentence this directory relies on is the brand's current product page.
labelNote: PFAS-free is the brand's statement on the current product page. A 2015 RADIUS ingredient line names candelilla wax for this floss name. This directory has not run its own test.
